create_HubCacheWatcher: create a HubCacheWatcher instance to monitor dataset-hub-cache entries in a MongoDB collection
run_HubCacheWatcher_initialization: run the HubCacheWatcher initialization loop to publish events for all existing cache entries
start_HubCacheWatcher_watching: start the HubCacheWatcher change stream loop to detect real-time cache entry modifications
subscribe_HubCacheWatcher: subscribe to HubCacheWatcher events to receive notifications when dataset cache entries change
wait_HubCacheChangedEvent: wait for a HubCacheChangedEvent to fire and retrieve the associated dataset cache value
